newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse to provide indices without dividends.
newsitem.headline: German bourse to provide indices without dividends.

text.p: The German stock exchange said on Tuesday it was starting to calculate indices for the blue-chip DAX index of 30 leading shares and the midcap MDAX index excluding dividend payments.
The normal DAX and MDAX indices include dividend payments. The new indices, DAXK and MKDX, will be calculated twice daily from today, October 1, the stock exchange said in a statement.
